request_payload.title: From Symptomatic Therapies to Disease-Modifying Approaches for Neuronal Sodium Channel Disorders.

mentions.sentence: Additionally, pharmacological agents such as fenfluramine, stiripentol, and cannabidiol, although not acting directly on sodium channels, represent recognized therapeutic options for SCN1A-related Dravet syndrome.

candidates.label: Potassium channel activity
candidates.summary: Enables the energy-independent facilitated diffusion of a potassium ion through a transmembrane aqueous pore or channel.

candidates.label: Intracellular cholesterol transport
candidates.summary: The directed movement of cholesterol, cholest-5-en-3-beta-ol, within cells.

candidates.summary: The uptake of gamma-aminobutyric acid (GABA, 4-aminobutyrate) by neurons or glial cells. This process leads to inactivation and recycling of neurotransmitters.

mentions.sentence: Additionally, pharmacological agents such as fenfluramine, stiripentol, and cannabidiol, although not acting directly on sodium channels, represent recognized therapeutic options for SCN1A-related Dravet syndrome.

candidates.label: Cannabidiol (plant-derived, pharmaceutical)
candidates.summary: A purified cannabidiol oral solution with an FDA label covering seizures associated with Dravet syndrome.

candidates.label: AAV STXBP1 gene supplementation

candidates.label: Kv7 potassium channel openers (ezogabine / retigabine, XEN496)
candidates.summary: Drugs that open KCNQ2/KCNQ3 (Kv7) potassium channels, studied in KCNQ2 encephalopathy due to loss-of-function variants.

candidates.label: Quinidine (KCNT1 channel blocker, repurposed)
candidates.summary: An antiarrhythmic drug and partial KCNT1 antagonist tried in KCNT1 gain-of-function epilepsies, with mixed results.

candidates.label: Stiripentol
candidates.summary: An anti-seizure medicine with an FDA label for seizures associated with Dravet syndrome in patients taking clobazam.

candidates.label: 3,4-Diaminopyridine (amifampridine)
candidates.summary: A potassium-channel blocker that lengthens the nerve signal so more neurotransmitter is released. Used in presynaptic congenital myasthenic syndromes; reported

candidates.label: Aminopyridines (4-AP / 3,4-DAP) as a presynaptic boost
candidates.summary: The same class of potassium-channel blockers, used to push more neurotransmitter release when a SNARE-machinery variant has weakened it. Reported for VAMP2 and

candidates.label: Sodium channel blocking anti-seizure medicines (class)
candidates.summary: A class of established anti-seizure medicines that reduce sodium channel activity. Published responses differ by gene and by variant mechanism.

candidates.label: Ambroxol (repurposed pharmacological chaperone for glucocerebrosidase)
candidates.summary: A cough medicine that also acts as a chaperone for misfolded glucocerebrosidase and crosses the blood-brain barrier; studied in neuronopathic Gaucher disease. W

candidates.label: 4-Phenylbutyrate / glycerol phenylbutyrate (chemical chaperone)
candidates.summary: An FDA-approved drug (for urea-cycle disorders) that acts as a chemical chaperone, helping unstable or misfolded proteins fold and reach their working location.

mentions.sentence: Emerging strategies include antisense oligonucleotides, gene therapy, and selective small-molecule modulators, which have shown antiseizure potential in preclinical models and in initial clinical studies by modulating SCN gene expression and function.

candidates.label: KCNT1-targeting antisense oligonucleotide (knockdown)
candidates.summary: Antisense oligonucleotides that lower KCNT1 expression; tested in mice and given investigationally to two infants.

candidates.label: Scn8a-lowering antisense oligonucleotide (preclinical)
candidates.summary: An antisense oligonucleotide that lowers Scn8a; protective in mouse models of SCN8A encephalopathy and of Dravet syndrome.

candidates.label: Zorevunersen (STK-001, SCN1A TANGO antisense oligonucleotide)
candidates.summary: An antisense oligonucleotide designed to raise productive SCN1A (NaV1.1) expression; in phase 3 for Dravet syndrome.

candidates.label: Elsunersen (PRAX-222, SCN2A-targeting antisense oligonucleotide)
candidates.summary: An antisense oligonucleotide that lowers SCN2A expression, studied in early-onset gain-of-function SCN2A DEE.

candidates.label: Sodium channel blocking anti-seizure medicines (class)
candidates.summary: A class of established anti-seizure medicines that reduce sodium channel activity. Published responses differ by gene and by variant mechanism.

candidates.label: Enzyme replacement for Gaucher disease (imiglucerase, velaglucerase alfa, taliglucerase alfa)

candidates.label: Olipudase alfa (enzyme replacement for ASMD)
candidates.summary: Intravenous recombinant acid sphingomyelinase, approved only for the non-brain manifestations of ASMD.

candidates.label: Idursulfase (enzyme replacement for MPS II)
candidates.summary: Intravenous recombinant iduronate-2-sulfatase for Hunter syndrome (MPS II).
